detail: Stylam Industries Limited, a Kerala-based laminates and plywood manufacturer listed on NSE/BSE, has disclosed a substantial acquisition event under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure filing with NSE confirms entry of an acquirer into the 25%+ slab or crossing of a 5% materiality threshold.
